correctness.rationale: VC shattering iff independent in M and its dual by all-positive/all-negative and basis extension. Edmonds matroid intersection theorem yields the dual rank minimum. For every element neither loop nor coloop, both contraction and deletion rank expressions are one less than the corresponding partition of the rank minimum, so each eligible root has the identical optimal-depth recurrence; the precise Littlestone recursion then gives equality and universal root optimality by induction. Verified concrete computations on 1,347 binary represented matroids and imbalanced ten-element example; these finite experiments are corroboration, not unrestricted proof.
